hero.unTableroDeCorcho: A digital corkboard for your PC: pin notes, photos, lists and stickers. Connect them with threads like in detective movies and organize your ideas in boards and sheets. And if you get stuck, Chinche, the AI assistant, gives you ideas. Everything stays on your computer.
hero.windows10Y11: Windows 10 and 11 · Intel, AMD and ARM
hero.animacionAlguienCreaNotas: Animation: someone creates notes, connects ideas with threads and groups them in a zone

funciones.yLoQueUn: …and what a real board can't do
funciones.pensadoParaQueLo: Made to use without a manual: drag, pin and done.
funciones.notasAdhesivasDeColores: Colorful sticky notes, cards with a title and to-do lists that cross themselves off.
funciones.arrastraImagenesPegaCapturas: Drag images, paste screenshots with Ctrl+V, add links with a preview and attach PDFs.
funciones.arrastraDeUnaChinche: Drag from one pin to another to string a thread. Give it a color, a label and tension.
funciones.agrupaConZonasQue: Group with zones that carry their contents, or with Ctrl+G to move everything together.
funciones.organizaTablerosEnGrupos: Organize boards in groups and each board in sheets, like Excel tabs.
funciones.ctrlKBuscaCualquier: Ctrl+K finds any note, photo or list in every sheet and jumps straight to it.
funciones.fondoDeCorchoPuntos: Cork, dots or grid background, in a light or dark theme. Your choice.
funciones.guardadoAutomaticoDeshacerY: Autosave, undo and redo, and a 30-day trash. If something gets damaged, Chinchero recovers it.
funciones.sinCuentasNiNube: No accounts and no mandatory cloud. Everything stays in a folder you can copy wherever you like.
funciones.guardaUnaHojaComo: Save a sheet as a PNG image or PDF, or hand over a whole board in a .chinchero file.
funciones.flechasCirculosYGarabatos: Arrows, circles and doodles on the board with the pencil, and an eraser to remove strokes.
funciones.cambiaLosAtajosUsalo: Change the shortcuts, use it entirely with the keyboard or a screen reader, and turn on sounds if you like them.
funciones.yCopiasDeSeguridad: Plus one-click .zip backups, and an automatic one every time you open Chinchero.

asistente.pideleIdeasYLas: Ask it for ideas and it pins them for you
asistente.hazClicEnLa: Click the pin in the corner and type what you need. Everything it does can be undone with Ctrl+Z.
asistente.proponeIdeasSobreLo: Suggests ideas about what's on the sheet or what you selected, as notes connected with threads.
asistente.armaUnPlanDe: “Put together a trip plan for Japan”: it creates notes, cards, lists, zones and new sheets.
asistente.resumeUnaHojaEn: Summarizes a sheet in a card, groups by topic into zones or gathers pending tasks in a list.
asistente.pideleUnCaballoUn: Ask for a horse, a map or Mount Fuji and it draws it freehand on the board.
asistente.loMasFacilCon: The easiest option: with your Google account and a free key that Chinchero helps you get step by step.
asistente.chincheroLoInstalaPor: Chinchero installs it for you, with no windows: the AI runs on your PC and nothing leaves your computer.
asistente.vieneDesactivadoLoActivas: It's off by default: turn it on in Settings → AI assistant only if you want it.

como.ySiTePierdes: And if you get lost, every screen has a guided tutorial and tips that show up at the right moment.
como.pulsaNHazClic: Press N, click wherever you like and type.
como.arrastraDeUnaChinche: Drag from one pin to another. That simple.
como.unaZonaMueveTodo: A zone moves everything inside it.
como.ctrlKYEscribe: Ctrl+K and type: it takes you straight there.

capturas.cambiaElTemaArriba: Change the theme at the top right to see them in light or dark.

descargar.unInstaladorParaWindows: One installer for Windows. New versions install themselves.
descargar.windows10U11: 64-bit Windows 10 or 11, with an Intel, AMD or ARM processor
descargar.noNecesitaInternetPara: No internet needed to use it
descargar.asistenteConIaOpcional: AI assistant (optional): internet for Gemini, or about 6 GB more for offline Ollama
descargar.windowsMuestraUnAviso: Does Windows show a warning when installing? It's normal for new apps without a commercial signature: click “More info” → “Run anyway”.

preguntas.siTotalmenteYEl: Yes, completely. And the code is open source: you can see it on GitHub.
preguntas.elAsistenteConIa: Does the AI assistant cost anything?
preguntas.noConGeminiUsas: No. With Gemini you use Google's free plan with your own key (it has a daily quota; if it runs out, wait a while). With Ollama the AI runs on your PC, with no quotas or internet, though slower if you don't have a graphics card.
preguntas.misTablerosSeEnvian: Are my boards sent to the internet?
preguntas.soloSiUsasEl: Only if you use the assistant with Gemini: the text of the sheet you have open goes to Google so it can answer. With Ollama, or with the assistant turned off (as it comes), nothing leaves your PC.
preguntas.enLaCarpetaDocumentos: In the Documents\Chinchero folder (you can change it in Settings). The images you pin are copied there, so they don't get lost even if you move the originals.
preguntas.puedoPasarMisTableros: Can I move my boards to another computer?
preguntas.siEnAjustesDatos: Yes: in Settings → Data make a backup (.zip) and on the other computer choose “Restore backup”. You can also copy the whole folder and choose “Open existing data”.
preguntas.siExportarTableroGuarda: Yes: “Export board…” saves a .chinchero file with its images, which the other person opens with a double-click. You can also export a sheet as a PNG image or PDF.
preguntas.chincheroBuscaVersionesNuevas: Chinchero looks for new versions when it opens, downloads them in the background and installs them when you close it. You can also check manually in Settings → About.
preguntas.funcionaEnPcsCon: Does it work on PCs with an ARM processor (Snapdragon)?
preguntas.siHayUnInstalador: Yes, there's a dedicated ARM64 installer. The download button picks the right one for your PC; if your browser doesn't report it, it downloads the Intel and AMD one, which also works on ARM, though slower. If you already installed it that way, install the ARM64 version on top: your boards aren't touched.
preguntas.hayVersionParaMac: Is there a version for Mac or Linux?
preguntas.porAhoraSoloWindows: Only Windows for now. If you're interested in another platform, say so on GitHub.
preguntas.encontreUnErrorO: I found a bug or have an idea
preguntas.abreUnIssueEn: Open an issue in the GitHub repository. Every suggestion helps!

final.tusIdeasMerecenUn: Your ideas deserve a good board
